claims.text: ASP.NET Core's default configuration reads appsettings.json, then appsettings.{Environment}.json, user secrets in Development, environment variables and command-line arguments; later sources override earlier ones for the same key.
claims.source_hint: ASP.NET Core docs: Configuration (default configuration sources)

claims.text: In environment variable names, a double underscore __ is replaced by : in configuration keys (e.g. ConnectionStrings__Default -> ConnectionStrings:Default, Logging__LogLevel__Default).
claims.source_hint: ASP.NET Core docs: Configuration, environment variables (__ separator)

claims.text: docker-compose.yml@stage-1 lines 89-93 give the api ConnectionStrings__Default (Host=db, password from ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}), Jwt__SigningKey from ${JWT_SIGNING_KEY}, and ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT Development.
The API's appsettings.json holds Logging levels, AllowedHosts and Jwt Issuer/Audience only; no connection string and no signing key; Program.cs reads ConnectionStrings:Default and Jwt:SigningKey.

printenv in donhang-api shows ConnectionStrings__Default=Host=db;... and ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development (plus other ASPNETCORE_ lines); docker run --rm donhang-api:stage-1 stops with InvalidOperationException: ConnectionStrings:Default is not set.

claims.text: Config is what varies between the places an app runs; keeping it out of code lets one build run anywhere.
